subject: history
title: Mao and the People's Republic
welcome_lead: From the 1949 proclamation to the Cultural Revolution: Mao remakes China.
meta_desc: A-Level history adventure on Mao Zedong, Great Leap Forward and Cultural Revolution.
final_note: You have watched a continent reshape itself.

concepts.def: Proclaimed by Mao Zedong on 1 October 1949 in Beijing after Communist victory over the Nationalists.
1950-53 redistribution of land from landlords to peasants, accompanied by struggle sessions and mass killings.
1956-57 invitation to criticise the party, swiftly reversed in the 1957 Anti-Rightist Campaign.
1958-62 push for collectivised communes and backyard steel; famine killed an estimated 30-45 million.
1966-76 campaign mobilising Red Guards to attack the Four Olds and remove Mao's rivals.
Breakdown of relations between Moscow and Beijing from 1960 over ideology, leadership and de-Stalinisation.

walkthroughs.h2: Why did the Communists win the Civil War?
walkthroughs.body_html: The CCP rebuilt strength during the Sino-Japanese War (1937-45), gaining peasant support through land policies in Yan'an. The Nationalists suffered hyperinflation, corruption and exhaustion. After Soviet aid in Manchuria and decisive Communist victories at Liaoshen and Huaihai in 1948-49, PLA forces crossed the Yangtze in April 1949. Chiang Kai-shek fled to Taiwan in December.

Launched in 1958, the Great Leap forced rural communes of up to 20,000 households and promoted backyard steel furnaces. Inflated production claims led to excessive grain procurement. The resulting Great Famine of 1959-62 killed an estimated 30-45 million (Frank Dikotter). Mao retreated from frontline politics, ceding day-to-day management to Liu Shaoqi and Deng Xiaoping until 1966.

Mao launched the Cultural Revolution in May 1966 to reassert ideological purity. Red Guards attacked teachers, officials and the Four Olds. Liu Shaoqi was purged and died in 1969. The PLA restored order from 1968; the Gang of Four wielded power in the early 1970s. Mao's death on 9 September 1976 was followed by their arrest in October. Deng's reforms began in 1978.

Cultural Revolution
Hundred Flowers

mcqs.q: What did the 1832 Great Reform Act actually do?
options: Magna Carta abolished the monarchy and created Parliament.
The 1832 Reform Act allowed women to vote for the first time.
The 1832 Reform Act gave the vote to all working men.
It abolished rotten boroughs, redistributed seats to industrial towns, and extended the vote to about 1 in 5 adult men — still far short of democracy.

mcqs.q: What did Magna Carta actually do in 1215?
options: It was a peace treaty between King John and rebel barons protecting baronial privileges and limiting arbitrary royal taxation and imprisonment — it was annulled within months.
Magna Carta gave ordinary English people democratic rights and freedom.
William of Orange was Charles II's son and inherited the throne.
Magna Carta abolished the monarchy and created Parliament.

mcqs.q: Why is 1688 called the Glorious Revolution?
options: William of Orange was Charles II's son and inherited the throne.
Magna Carta abolished the monarchy and created Parliament.
Parliament invited William of Orange to replace the Catholic James II, with little bloodshed in England, establishing parliamentary supremacy and the 1689 Bill of Rights.
It was glorious because no one died anywhere in the conflict.
